title: Curated <ls> siglum alias table — abbreviation-length variants to canonical fold-key
description: Human-adjudicated merge decisions for the prefix-clustered siglum families in data/obs/siglum_family_candidates.csv. Only ACCEPTED merges appear in 'aliases'; families or members ruled distinct works appear in 'distinctWorks' with their identity; unresolved members stay in 'uncertain' and must not be merged. Locator-suffix pseudo-variants (raghiii, dhatupxxxii, mbhi, paniv ...) are deliberately NOT listed as aliases: they are parsing artifacts to be removed at fold level (see foldRuleFixes). Grown in monthly adjudication batches per MWS ROADMAP.md workstream W4 track 1.
canonicalRule: The canonical key is the fold of the standard modern siglum (usually the Monier-Williams list form) when one exists in the family; otherwise the highest-frequency member.
foldRuleFixes: baseForm/foldSiglum must strip trailing lowercase roman-numeral locator tokens (i, ii, ... xxxv) before family clustering; this removes ~120 pseudo-members across ragh/susr/dhatup/pan/mbh/aitbr/laty/mrcch/nais/gobh/yajn/katysr/maitrs/sarvad/bhatt/vikr/prab/balar/dasar/rajat/kathas/naigh and empties several families entirely.
The siglum_families.py docstring points at src/data/dict-source-aliases.json; the curated table lives at src/data/dicts/dict-source-aliases.json (this file) — align the docstring.
